# ReviewBuddy

> ReviewBuddy helps Australian trade businesses get more Google reviews and shows them on their own website. Set up for you.

## What it does

- Gives each business one review link and a QR code. The customer picks the review site, such as Google or Facebook.
- Shows reviews on the business's own website, with the rating and review count. They update when a new one comes in.
- Growth plan: an automatic review request after each job, one polite reminder, and past customers asked too.
- Setup is free on both plans.

## Offer and prices

- 7-day free trial, no card needed. Add a card before day 8 to keep going.
- If you haven't added a card by day 8, the account pauses. Review requests and syncing stop until a card is added in the app.
- Cancel any time from the billing page in the account. Access stays until the end of the billing period.
- Starter: $49 a month, AUD. You do the asking.
- Growth: $75 a month, AUD. The asking happens without you.
- Try Starter free for 7 days goes to Embed My Reviews registration with plan 5. Try Growth free for 7 days goes to plan 6. The trial is not stored on this website.
